replies.author: hasl
replies.body:
Hey EnderFade, I noticed you've been around for about two years, so did you finally decide to join the forum community? Welcome and oh yeah: toilets are down the hall to the left. (locks a bit stiff) :)

  1. When was the last time you cried?
  2. Do you sing whilst taking a shower/bath?
  3. If you could live anywhere in the world, where would it be?
  4. What 5 words would a close friend use to describe you?
  5. If emotions could be expressed as colours, which would relaxed be?
  6. What is your favourite month of the year?
  7. What was your first impression of me?
Take it easy, - Itset

.
